claims.text: ClarifyGPT elevates the Pass@1 performance of GPT-4 from 70.96% to 80.80% on the MBPP-sanitized benchmark in user evaluation.
ClarifyGPT improves the average performance of GPT-4 across five benchmarks from 62.43% to 69.60% using simulated user responses.
ClarifyGPT improves the average performance of ChatGPT across five benchmarks from 54.32% to 62.37% using simulated user responses.
ClarifyGPT detects requirement ambiguity through a code consistency check.

evidence.description: Ten participants evaluated ClarifyGPT, showing Pass@1 for GPT-4 increased from 70.96% to 80.80% on MBPP-sanitized.
Automated simulation across five benchmarks showed GPT-4 average performance increased from 62.43% to 69.60%.
Automated simulation across five benchmarks showed ChatGPT average performance increased from 54.32% to 62.37%.
ClarifyGPT first detects whether a given requirement is ambiguous by performing a code consistency check.

methodologies.name: ClarifyGPT Framework
methodologies.description: A framework that detects ambiguous code requirements via code consistency checks, generates clarifying questions, and refines requirements before generating code solutions.
conditions: Automated evaluation using high-fidelity user response simulation

limitations.text: Current LLMs directly generate programs according to unclear or ambiguous requirements without performing interactive clarification.
